newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy seen posting larger 6-mth profit-paper.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy seen posting larger 6-mth profit-paper.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of about 10 billion yen in the six months to September 30, about 4.5 times as large as its actual interim current profit in the year-earlier period, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.
Fuji Heavy was not immediately available for comment.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that its estimate was based on the yen's weaker trend and the company's restructuring efforts. The paper said its estimate of Fuji Heavy's interim parent current profit was about three billion yen bigger than the company's latest forecast.
